verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party SDKs that developers build against: a drop-in SDK, a Python SDK with an AI agents module and APIs like `set_conversation_id()`, and a versioned JavaScript/Node SDK (v11.0.0) that auto-instruments popular AI SDKs. A community user reports the native integration was very simple. Missing for 10: an enumerated catalog of language SDKs and SDK API reference depth in the evidence, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of SDK development beyond a single integration report.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Drop in the [SDK](https://sentry.io/platforms/). No agents to install.
As of SDK version `11.0.0`, Sentry auto-instruments the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks out of the box
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
